process_steps.title: Get QR Code
process_steps.description: After purchase, your unique QR code is delivered instantly to your account dashboard and email. Save the QR code image to your phone's gallery.

process_steps.title: Open VN Video Editor
process_steps.description: Open the VN Video Editor app on your mobile device.

process_steps.title: Open Your Projects
process_steps.description: Tap the X icon in the top-left corner to go to the Your Projects screen.

process_steps.title: Scan QR Code
process_steps.description: Tap the scan icon (QR code icon or plus sign) in the VN app, then select the QR code IMAGE from your phone gallery. The template loads instantly!

process_steps.title: Replace Clips
process_steps.description: Tap Use and replace the demo clips with your own photos or videos.

process_steps.title: Export Video
process_steps.description: Tap Export and your reel is ready to post on Instagram.
